title: AI worker task result (handoff)
description: The AI-to-AI handoff produced by every task execution. Frozen shape from orchestrator/README.md -> 'AI-to-AI handoff format'. The next worker reads this plus the repository state -- never a conversation transcript.

task_id.description: TASK-### as it appears on the GitHub issue.

status.description: DONE/PARTIAL mean code was written and validation ran. BLOCKED means the worker stopped deliberately (scope, missing dependency). PROPOSAL means the task needed human authorization, so no code was written.

summary.description: What was actually done. Never inferred: if the AI returned no summary, this says so.

changed_files.description: Repository-relative paths, all of which must lie inside the task's allowed_paths.

skipped.description: Gates that did not run. Never counted as passed.

new_dependencies.description: Anything added to a requirements/package file. A non-empty list requires human authorization (CONTRIBUTING.md 5).

recommended_next_tasks.description: Alias of next_recommended_tasks, emitted so readers using either spelling work. Always identical in content.

requires_human_review.description: Forced true by an ADR requirement, an experiment, or a scope violation.

run.description: Provenance for this execution: who ran it, where, and what the worker observed.
